name: air-purifier-standalone
title: Air Purifier (Standalone)

description: The Krastorio 2 air purifier as a standalone building for vanilla, with a configurable absorption radius. Filters are made in the chemical plant from steel, plastic and coal. Code and graphics from Krastorio 2 / Krastorio2Assets (LGPL-3.0, sounds MIT).
